name: advise-remediation
description: Pull the latest detailed findings for a repository and recommend prioritised approaches to address the critical/high issues.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the visible registered Assurance Scan project.

prompt:
Use the `assurance-scan` MCP server. Goal: recommend approaches to address the critical issues for registered project {{project_id}}.

1. Call `get_project_findings` with project_id={{project_id}} and severity="CRITICAL". If empty, retry with severity="HIGH".
2. Cluster the findings by rule_id and theme — a cluster shares one root cause and one fix.
3. For each cluster, recommend an approach. Use the finding's `fix_strategy` when present; prefer config changes and dependency bumps over code rewrites when they fix the same rule.
4. Order clusters by severity, then finding count, then whether any finding carries compliance_tags.
5. Present a table: cluster | findings | affected files | recommended approach | effort (S/M/L).
6. Offer to act: `code-finding-fix` for config-level fixes, `code-fr-test` when a test proves the fix, `scan-project` to re-scan and verify.

Every row must cite rule_id and file paths taken from the payload — do not invent findings.
